basic_info.description: Every now and then, a home comes along that just feels meant to be. Penthouse #306 at Union SF is a rare blend of historic character and modern luxury. This contemporary 3-bedroom, 3-bath townhome offers designer finishes, two parking spaces (EV Charger), and additional storage an exceptional combination in the city.  The living room's exposed red brick and rich architectural details create a warm, distinctive setting for everyday living and entertaining. The chef's kitchen balances beauty and function with Viking appliances, Carrara marble counters, Ann Sacks tile, and Brookside cabinetry.  Upstairs, the primary suite and guest bedroom each feature generous closets, spa-inspired en-suite baths, and easy access to laundry. A spacious private sky terrace links both bedrooms, providing the perfect setting for morning coffee, evening gatherings, or a quiet moment under the open sky.  Just beyond your door, you'll find some of the city's best coffee shops, stylish boutiques, and acclaimed restaurants placing the best of San Francisco's vibrant lifestyle right at your fingertips.
